text:
My family has been receiving treatment at this clinic since high school, and now that I'm working, I've never considered going anywhere else. The team of doctors is very meticulous and gentle, especially if you get Dr. Saroj – that's incredibly lucky, his touch is ten times gentler!

You can park at Big C across the street. After your dental appointment, there's a Go Ang Hainanese Chicken Rice restaurant right next to the clinic.

restaurant_name: Clinic Ruk Fun by Dentist Sarote Boonsin
text:
I've been getting dental treatment here for over 10 years. I'm 51 now. I get regular checkups, teeth cleaning, night guards, root canal treatment, and dental implants – the most expensive thing I've ever done in my life, costing tens of thousands of baht, but it's totally worth it. I made the right decision and highly recommend this clinic.
Good work, clean, affordable, and consistent care. I'm very impressed.

I recommend inquiring, booking an appointment, and discussing your needs and preferences.
Parking is available at the mall across the street, probably Top or Big C. Get your parking ticket stamped for free parking at the clinic.

There's also a Go Ang Hainanese Chicken Rice shop that just opened next to the dental clinic. You can stop by for a meal!
